deadline.value: Fall 2027 priority deadline is February 1 for applicants seeking funding (April 1 for all other Fall applicants; Spring 2027 deadline September 15).
deadline.quote: Fall 2027: Applicants seeking funding February 1, all other applicants April 1

gre_general.value: GRE General is required for most applicants (typical competitive scores 150V / 160Q); automatically waived for a U.S. computing M.S. with GPA >= 3.3, and waiver petitions are accepted >= 1 month before deadline for U.S. computing B.S. >= 3.6 GPA, 5+ years U.S. IT experience, or peer-reviewed computing publications.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are required for most applicants but are only one component of a holistic admission decision.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers GRE Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology (none in Computer Science or Data Science).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: Program requires internet-based TOEFL 90 (above Graduate Council's 80 / 4.0 new-scale minimum).

ielts_min.value: Program requires IELTS 7.0 (above Graduate Council's 6.5 minimum).

supervisor.value: Applicants are advised to identify matching faculty in their statement of purpose and reach out via email to faculty prior to applying.
supervisor.quote: identify specific research areas that interest you in your statement of purpose, and explicitly mention faculty names with whom you see a good match. Feel free to reach out via email to our faculty prior to submitting your application to discuss your interest.

funding.value: Competitive Graduate Assistantships (20 hrs/week, monthly salary, tuition waiver up to 12 credits/semester, subsidized health insurance, capped at 6 semesters beyond a master's) and doctoral fellowships (separate fellowship interest letter; Feb 1 funding deadline).
funding.quote: If you are interested in applying for a doctoral fellowship, please submit a letter stating your interest in the fellowship | Fall 2027: Applicants seeking funding February 1

also.quote: As a graduate assistant you will be considered a UNO employee with a tuition waiver, monthly salary, and subsidized health insurance. | doctoral students are limited to six (6) semesters beyond their master's degree.
Partner with faculty on funded research projects | Gain experience through research assistantships

entry_route.value: Applicants with an earned bachelor's or master's degree in a computing discipline may apply directly to the 90-credit Ph.D.; up to 24 foundation credits may transfer from a prior computing master's degree.
entry_route.quote: Applicants with an earned undergraduate or graduate degree in a computing discipline (e.g., computer science, management information systems, bioinformatics, cybersecurity or a closely related discipline) can apply for admission to the PhD program. | Credit for graduate computing-related coursework in a prior degree may only be used to satisfy foundation course hours in the plan of study.

notes: STEM-OPT eligible Ph.D. in Computing & Information Science covering core computer science, cybersecurity, data analytics, and the Artificial Intelligence Concentration (also mapped to datasci), plus Computing Systems, Human-Centered Computing, and IT Project Management concentrations. Requires 90 graduate credits, statement of purpose (max 2 pages), CV, 2 letters of recommendation (3rd optional), and GRE waiver requests at least 1 month before the deadline.
name: Computing & Information Science, Ph.D.
